id: 10_Replace the Pneumatic Assembly for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊接机气动组件的规范更换
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/10_Replace the Pneumatic Assembly for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/10_Replace the Pneumatic Assembly for xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.K19: 装光纤固定块，扎好线缆
points.S1: 拆气管前：关气源、放余压
points.S3: 传输光纤不弯折、不踩压

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一台侧板打开的激光焊接机旁，机内露出蓝色气管，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a gray wheeled laser welding machine with its side panel open, blue air tubes visible inside, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课，看焊机的气动组件怎样更换。
overlay: 激光焊接机气动组件的规范更换

shots.scene: 四个图标：气瓶阀门、两个人抬箱子、一圈光纤、肥皂泡
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a gas cylinder valve, two people lifting a box, a coiled cable and soap bubbles. No people.
shots.narration: 管气、管电、管光纤，还要管好搬动。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着焊枪按扳机，焊枪口没有气流，他一脸疑惑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student presses the trigger of a handheld welding gun; no gas flows from the nozzle and he looks puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰发现焊枪按下去，不出保护气了。

shots.scene: 老李检查后摇头，指着机身里的气动组件位置示意图
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer shakes his head after checking and points at a simple diagram showing an air valve block inside the machine.
shots.narration: 老李判断：机器里的气动组件坏了。

shots.scene: 小研把阿杰拉到一旁，地上画出黄色维修区域线
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the young male student aside while a yellow line marks off a repair area on the floor.
shots.narration: 小研说：要拆大半台机器，我们站远点看。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着黄黑边框警示卡，卡面只有闪电和人形打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a warning card with a yellow and black striped border, showing a lightning bolt icon and a crossed-out person icon.
shots.narration: 和所有维修一样，只限专业人员动手。

shots.scene: 老李把焊机电源开关拨到关
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches the main power switch of the laser welding machine to off.
shots.narration: 动手之前，先关机断电。

shots.scene: 机箱剖面示意：一边闪电图标，一边激光束图标
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a machine cabinet with a lightning bolt icon on one side and a red laser beam icon on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 机内有高压和强激光，会触电、烧伤。

shots.scene: 拔掉插头的焊机内部，一个模块上还亮着闪电图标，旁边沙漏
shots.prompt_en: Inside an unplugged machine cabinet, one module still shows a glowing lightning bolt icon, with an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 断电后电源里仍有残余高压，要等待。

shots.scene: 老李戴上厚绝缘手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls on thick insulated gloves.
shots.narration: 全程戴好绝缘手套。

shots.scene: 工作台上摆着两把十字螺丝刀、一把剪刀、五根扎带和一个新气动组件
shots.prompt_en: On a workbench lie two cross-head screwdrivers of different sizes, a pair of scissors, five cable ties and a new blank air valve block with blue tubes. No people.
shots.narration: 备好两把十字刀、剪刀和五根扎带。

shots.scene: 老李把新气动组件从盒子里拿出来看了看
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the new air valve block out of its box and inspects it.
shots.narration: 还有新的气动组件。

shots.scene: 焊机背面接口全部空着，电源线和焊枪线放在一边
shots.prompt_en: The back of the laser welding machine with all sockets empty; the unplugged power cable and the gun cable lie coiled on the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 确认所有电线和管线都已断开。

shots.section_title: 拆气管前：关气源、放余压
shots.scene: 老李关闭保护气气瓶的阀门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer in gloves closes the valve on a shielding gas cylinder chained to the wall.
shots.narration: 气路也要断：先关气瓶或气源阀门。
overlay: 拆气管前：关气源、放余压

shots.section_title: 拆气管前：关气源、放余压
shots.scene: 焊枪对着空处按一下，压力表指针回到零位，表盘空白
shots.prompt_en: The welding gun is pointed at an empty area and triggered briefly while a blank pressure gauge needle drops to its rest position.
shots.narration: 再把管路里剩下的气放掉。

shots.section_title: 拆气管前：关气源、放余压
shots.scene: 带压拔管、气管甩动打到脸的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a pressurized tube whipping toward a face when pulled off, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 带压拔管，管子会甩出伤人。

shots.scene: 老李踩下脚轮刹车
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake on a caster wheel with his foot.
shots.narration: 四个脚轮全部锁住。

shots.scene: 焊机静静放着，墙上时钟指针转动
shots.prompt_en: The closed laser welding machine stands still while a wall clock shows time passing. No people.
shots.narration: 按说明书规定静置，放电、冷却。

shots.scene: 地上铺好软垫，机器准备朝左侧放倒
shots.prompt_en: A thick soft mat is laid on the floor beside the laser welding machine, ready for it to be tipped onto its left side. No people.
shots.narration: 拆右侧板，要把机器左侧朝下放倒。

shots.scene: 机器侧躺在软垫上
shots.prompt_en: The laser welding machine lies on its left side on the soft mat. No people.
shots.narration: 机器很重，着地面要垫上软垫。

shots.scene: 老李和小研一人一头，弯腰扶住机器缓缓放倒
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the female graduate student each hold one end of the machine, bending their knees, and slowly tip it onto the mat together.
shots.narration: 放倒和扶正，两个人一起慢慢来。

shots.scene: 手脚伸到机器下方的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand and a foot placed under a tipping machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 手脚别放在机器下面，防压伤。

shots.scene: 老李拧下底部固定右侧板的螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the screws holding the right side panel at the bottom of the machine.
shots.narration: 拧下固定右侧板的三颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 取下右侧的线缆挂架，线缆放在软垫上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer takes off the round cable holder on the right side and lays the gun cable on the soft mat.
shots.narration: 取下线缆挂架，再取下右侧板。

shots.section_title: 传输光纤不弯折、不踩压
shots.scene: 焊枪线缆截面示意，中间一根细光纤发亮
shots.prompt_en: A simple cross-section diagram of the welding gun cable with a thin glowing optical fiber in its center. No people.
shots.narration: 焊枪线缆里，有一根传输激光的光纤。
overlay: 传输光纤不弯折、不踩压

shots.section_title: 传输光纤不弯折、不踩压
shots.scene: 线缆打死弯、被脚踩的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a cable bent into a sharp kink and a cable under a shoe, both crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不能打死弯，不能踩，不能压重物。

shots.section_title: 传输光纤不弯折、不踩压
shots.scene: 线缆顺着大弧度盘在软垫上
shots.prompt_en: The gun cable rests in a wide gentle loop on the soft mat. No people.
shots.narration: 放下时盘成大圈，光纤才不会受伤。

shots.scene: 右侧板打开后，机内模块上贴着黄色激光警告标签
shots.prompt_en: With the right panel off, a metal laser module inside shows a yellow laser warning label with a triangle laser symbol and blank text. No people.
shots.narration: 打开右侧，能看到激光器模块。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着放大的激光警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a large triangular laser warning sign.
shots.narration: 这个标志提醒：这里会产生激光。

shots.scene: 欣欣摇手，模块外壳上的螺钉打叉
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves a paw; the screws on the laser module cover are marked with a red X.
shots.narration: 激光器模块本身，维修时不要打开。

shots.scene: 桌面铺好泡沫，机器平放在上面
shots.prompt_en: A layer of cushioning foam is spread on a workbench and the machine lies flat on it. No people.
shots.narration: 把机器平放在铺了泡沫的桌面上。

shots.scene: 老李拧下气动组件下方的三颗固定螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes three fixing screws under the air valve block from the bottom of the machine.
shots.narration: 拆下气动组件下方的三颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 两人一起把机器扶正
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer and the female graduate student lift the machine back to its upright position together.
shots.narration: 再把机器扶正。

shots.scene: 斜口钳小心剪断扎带，旁边线缆完好
shots.prompt_en: Close view of flush cutters carefully snipping a cable tie while the nearby cables stay intact.
shots.narration: 剪断五根扎带，别剪到旁边的线。

shots.scene: 剪下的扎带断头放进小盒
shots.prompt_en: Cut cable tie ends are dropped into a small parts tray. No people.
shots.narration: 剪下的断头马上收走。

shots.scene: 断头掉进机内的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a cable tie end falling into a machine cabinet, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 掉进机内的碎片，可能卡住风扇。

shots.scene: 手指按下快插接头的卡套，拔出蓝色气管
shots.prompt_en: Close view of gloved fingers pressing the collar of a push-fit connector and pulling out a blue air tube.
shots.narration: 按住接头卡套，拔出蓝色气管。

shots.scene: 硬拽气管的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand yanking a tube out of a connector without pressing the collar, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不按卡套硬拽，会损坏接头。

shots.scene: 老李打开焊机左侧门板，拆送丝安装板螺钉
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens the left side door and removes the screws of the wire feeder mounting plate.
shots.narration: 打开左侧门板，拆安装板十四颗螺钉。

shots.scene: 拆接地线螺钉，把安装板放平
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the yellow-green earth wire screw and lays the mounting plate down.
shots.narration: 拆下接地线，把安装板放平。

shots.scene: 主板上两个插头被画圈，老李拔下
shots.prompt_en: Two connectors on the main board are highlighted with circles, and the facility engineer unplugs them.
shots.narration: 从主板拔下气动组件的两根线。

shots.scene: 老李把旧气动组件整个取出
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls the whole old air valve block out of the machine.
shots.narration: 把整个旧组件取出来。

shots.scene: 新组件的两根线从右侧穿进，从左侧伸出
shots.prompt_en: Two cables of the new air valve block are routed from the right side of the cabinet through to the left side.
shots.narration: 新组件的两根线，从右边穿到左边。

shots.scene: 插头插回主板
shots.prompt_en: The two connectors are plugged back into the main board.
shots.narration: 插回主板原来的位置。

shots.scene: 抬回安装板，插回送丝电机线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the mounting plate back and plugs the wire feeder motor cable into the main board.
shots.narration: 抬回安装板，接回送丝电机线。

shots.scene: 装回接地线和螺钉，关上左侧门板
shots.prompt_en: The earth wire and screws are refitted and the left side door is closed.
shots.narration: 装回接地线和螺钉，关好左门板。

shots.scene: 蓝色气管两端插进快插接头
shots.prompt_en: Both ends of the blue air tube are pushed firmly into the push-fit connectors.
shots.narration: 两端接回蓝色气管，插到底。

shots.scene: 机器平放，装回底部三颗螺钉，再扶正
shots.prompt_en: The machine is laid flat to refit the three bottom screws, then lifted upright by two people.
shots.narration: 装回底部螺钉，再两人扶正。

shots.section_title: 装光纤固定块，扎好线缆
shots.scene: 老李装回光纤固定块
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer refits the small fixing block that holds the optical fiber cable in place.
shots.narration: 装回光纤固定块，把光纤固定好。
overlay: 装光纤固定块，扎好线缆

shots.section_title: 装光纤固定块，扎好线缆
shots.scene: 线缆理顺，用五根扎带捆好
shots.prompt_en: The cables are neatly arranged and bundled with five cable ties.
shots.narration: 线缆理顺，用五根扎带扎好。

shots.scene: 接头处涂肥皂水，没有冒泡
shots.prompt_en: Soapy water is brushed on the push-fit connectors and no bubbles appear. No people.
shots.narration: 通气后，接头抹肥皂水查漏气。

shots.scene: 接头冒出一串泡泡，旁边红色问号
shots.prompt_en: A connector with a stream of soap bubbles and a red question mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 冒泡就是漏气，关气重新接好。

shots.scene: 保护气在室内泄漏、人头晕的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of shielding gas leaking into a closed room and a dizzy person, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 保护气漏在屋里，会让人缺氧。

shots.scene: 老李装回右侧板，把焊接头线缆卡进侧板
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer refits the right side panel and secures the welding gun cable into its slot on the panel.
shots.narration: 装回右侧板，固定好焊接头线缆。

shots.scene: 拧紧三颗螺钉，线缆绕回挂架
shots.prompt_en: Three screws are tightened and the gun cable is wound in wide loops back onto the cable holder.
shots.narration: 拧紧螺钉，线缆绕回挂架。

shots.scene: 机器底部螺钉全部装回
shots.prompt_en: All the screws at the bottom of the machine are fastened. No people.
shots.narration: 最后装回底部螺钉。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊机旁，身后浮现四个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the laser welding machine with four icons behind: a closed valve, two people lifting, a coiled cable and soap bubbles.
shots.narration: 关气泄压，两人搬动，光纤盘大圈。

shots.scene: 欣欣伸出手指数着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot counts on its fingers.
shots.narration: 认得激光标志，收好断头，装完检漏。

shots.scene: 欣欣、老李、小研和阿杰在焊机前挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the facility engineer, the female graduate student and the young male student wave goodbye in front of the laser welding machine.
shots.narration: 气要管住，光要护住。下次见！
